items.title: Bitcoin Hits Lowest Price Since 2024 After Peter Brandt Warns of Deflation
items.description: Bitcoin plunged below $58,000 to hit its lowest price in over two years Friday as Peter Brandt warned that a sell-off across financial and raw material markets would likely lead to deflation. His forecast concerned the broader market, while the latest U.S. consumer-price data still showed inflation. Bitcoin Breaks Below $58,000 Veteran trader Peter Brandt […]

items.title: SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme
items.description: Bitcoin Magazine SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme The SEC obtained an asset freeze against Backward Hat Capital and its founders, alleging a $560 million Ponzi scheme sold as AI-driven FX trading funded through crypto. Prosecutors and the CFTC filed parallel cases. This post SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.description: Bitcoin is closing in on its $57,700 summer low as Delphi Digital strategist warns the Fed could make matters worse and STS Digital sees cash as the place to hide.

items.title: Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal
items.description: Bitcoin Magazine Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal Blockstream researchers published a 131-page security analysis of SHRINCS, a hash-based post-quantum signature scheme for Bitcoin, and are asking the community to review it for flaws. This post Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Bitcoin Price Crashes to $59,000 as Market Selloff Deepens
items.description: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Crashes to $59,000 as Market Selloff Deepens Bitcoin fell below $60,000 for the first time since early July on Friday as a tech stock rout, rate hike bets and record ETF outflows hit risk assets. This post Bitcoin Price Crashes to $59,000 as Market Selloff Deepens first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: U.S. Treasury Secretary Pushes Back on Bigger Fed Hike
items.description: Bitcoin Magazine U.S. Treasury Secretary Pushes Back on Bigger Fed Hike Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged the Fed not to embrace a bigger rate hike as Citi and traders still see a quarter-point move in December and bitcoin fell below $60,000. This post U.S. Treasury Secretary Pushes Back on Bigger Fed Hike first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
